description:
As a cloud architect, while migrating logging services, I need you to filter out all failed SSH login attempts from an authentication log file for further analysis. The log file is located at /home/user/migration/auth.log. Please extract and save only those lines from the log that match failed SSH logins (i.e., lines containing the phrase "Failed password") using a regex-based approach.

Create a new file named /home/user/migration/failed_ssh.log. This file should contain exclusively the lines from /home/user/migration/auth.log that indicate failed SSH login attempts, with each matching line being copied in full and in the original order. Do not include any other lines or modify their content or order.

After completing the filtering, check your output to ensure that no non-matching lines are present in /home/user/migration/failed_ssh.log. The output format should be line-for-line identical to those matching lines in the source log file.
